title: Six complete life/world/action coverage maps and their connected reports
head: 2aa6a2e4019e6177fb94eb76e397bc34faf78b8b

reviews.classification: Bounded historical connected-source research; coverage of the document separated from source/game coverage
reviews.disposition: The entire coverage map and report retain people/company/faction/crisis/event/recovery distinctions. Mood causes, wages/food, casualty/departure custody, retinue services and linked standing are selected script evidence, not a full relationship or kingdom/succession model. Swordmaster aging is level-gated rather than universal calendar aging.3114encrypted members,3239retained script/UI members,1109nonempty reconstructions,41selected source files and44findings are different denominators. Syntax compilation and selected bytecode/stat checks do not prove decompiler correctness; unresolved food-loop jump and crisis serialization discrepancy remain reconstruction questions. Numerical background arrays can be endpoints rather than final ranges. Ten DLC archives/depot labels establish presence, not entitlement or activation. The old remains-installed line is dated, not a current app observation. Keep useful agreement/standing/service/recovery/crisis ideas without imposing food death, generic loyalty decay or mandatory harshness on OOPS.

reviews.classification: Bounded historical connected-source research; coverage of the document separated from source/game coverage
reviews.disposition: The full map/report preserve learned vocabulary, gesture recognition, owned recipe, target eligibility, mana and actual effect as separate stages. Both recognizers converge to IDs before effects; a typed/menu/routine request can use the same effect without a drawing requirement. Ignition/dousing change actual eligible light state at their own boundary; remote object reach does not extend every NPC click or unlock a door; levitation changes collision and is not free flight. Upfront payment precedes some later dispatcher refusals without refund, a donor finding rather than a universal OOPS transaction policy. Stored precast metadata/current affordability/stored caster level and sustained upkeep differ from an idle job. All50definitions/factories/cost cases and49matching book recipes plus an explicit internal exception do not establish semantics of every spell. Missing commercial scripts/geometry/localization block named acquisition/puzzle/teleport/dialogue claims. Signed-out local/Steam/GOG checks do not prove worldwide nonownership. All past licence and account claims remain dated. Current retired-milestone and AD51/AD52 direction qualify the old one-realm scope; no engine replacement or data acquisition is selected.

reviews.classification: Bounded historical connected-source research; coverage of the document separated from source/game coverage
reviews.disposition: The full map/report preserve layered authored data rather than an executed native merge.59558records across four layers do not establish full semantics or final override precedence. Paid hire, persuasion, cage rescue, bought freedom and provisional travel have different join/leave outcomes; rescue does not confer membership or loyalty. Founding exposes real work, territorial visitors and involved-character retaliation; an editor tech-level label can mean town size. Multiple custodians/rulers and population replacement need their actual evaluator, not one ruler-dead boolean. Missing limbs, specialization, supplies and supported recovery inventory do not prove every escape, regrowth, resurrection, starvation XP or generic permanent follower desertion. Native combat/AI/needs, building transaction, raid scheduling, injury/XP triggers and save serializer remain unread. Red Basin is a separate original harsh-world proposal, not Reed Basin or current Frontier policy. Keep help-before-membership, practical skill/tool and social consequences without a new follower economy or actual gameplay claim.

reviews.classification: Bounded historical connected-source research; coverage of the document separated from source/game coverage
reviews.disposition: The complete map/report preserve perception, current target validation, action eligibility and actual result. Earlier sound/smell acquisition does not bypass the later visible-render target check. Current recursive body attachments, operational loaded weapon, reserve ammunition and available/cooling ability differ. The same-phase ally comparison is conditional on sampled ordering and actual equipped/loaded state, not a spawned or executed fixture. A safe-area selector can veto immediately without searching another region, while a clear narrow firing line remains possible. The ability helper samples at most three possibly repeated indices, not an exhaustive priority list. An inner fire/loading rejection can still leave the wrapper returning true and end selection; a miss is not necessarily fallback, and pushing a Step is not completed movement. Source damage/temperature consumers do not prove actual thermal results.22evidence groups/67complete method blocks/47types/19XML/config copies/32selected blueprints and large retained-byte counts have distinct scope. The serialized goal stack, whole-load reacquisition, item/magazine/socket/field identity, mod veto and spawned state remain unknown. Existing body/liquid traces are joined, not reaudited. Old one-prestige scope is retired; no new acquisition, AI, battle or generic event engine is selected.
